source_note: Copied from an earlier unpublished workspace. The original bytes are identified by original_sha256 and original_size; upstream paths are not published. Directory and namespace names were changed on 2026-10-27 (lean4/RENAMES.json).

ports: lines 370, 404: `rw [← rename_rename, ...] at h'` -> `rw [rename_rename, ...] at h'` (the 4.35 rewriter no longer unifies `rename ⇑π.symm _` with the pattern `rename (?σ ∘ ?π) _`; the forward rewrite gives the same term)

ReachNoRemove.toReach and ReachNoRemove.obstruction_persists: `induction h with | refl s u v` -> `| refl u v` (4.35 does not bind the field `s` that unification with the index already fixes); `Reach.refl s` -> `Reach.refl _`

obstruction_persists: the four inductive cases now bind their implicit fields with `@addTerm t u₀ v₀ u v w n r hw ih` (and the analogues for addAssertion, removeOther, identify) so that `t u v` are accessible; `obtain ... := ih` -> `ih huv₀` (the hypothesis is no longer generalised automatically); three `( _ ).Legal` / `( _ ).A` placeholders given explicitly; `mem_identify.2 ...` given its type
obstruction_persists_reach: `cases st with | addTerm _ w hw` and the analogues drop the leading `_` (the state field is fixed by unification in 4.35)
